_comment: DeepWarden responsible local IOC database. Behavioral red-flag patterns only — no exploit code, no payloads, no real campaign content. systemLookalikePatterns catch apps impersonating OS components; suspiciousPackagePatterns are generic stalkerware naming shapes.

redFlagCombos.name: Classic stalkerware skeleton
redFlagCombos.whyDangerous: Reads everything on screen, tracks location 24/7, never sleeps, and stays invisible. Each signal alone can be legitimate; together they define stalkerware.

redFlagCombos.name: SMS command-and-control
redFlagCombos.whyDangerous: Can be remote-controlled by text message, steal OTPs, and silently restart after every reboot.

redFlagCombos.name: Overlay banking trojan
redFlagCombos.whyDangerous: Draws fake login screens over real banking apps, auto-clicks its own permission grants, and can install further payloads.

redFlagCombos.name: Planted via physical access
signals: Installed while USB debugging was enabled
Device admin active for the same app
redFlagCombos.whyDangerous: The fingerprint of someone with hands on the phone: installed outside any store, possibly via ADB, then armored against uninstall with device-admin.
